title: Chorus puts all the best AI models on your Mac, side-by-side, in one open-source app #github
description:
What if you could talk to every top AI model at the same time — on your Mac? This is Chorus — an open-source desktop app that lets you chat with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and local models… side by side, in one place. No more guessing which model is right. Chorus shows you all their answers at once. Chorus can see what’s on your screen, so the models understand what you’re working on — no explaining, no context switching. 

https://github.com/meltylabs/chorus

#github #opensource
